name: clean-code-audit
description: Check code against fourteen smells: implicit coupling, layer-first folders, duplication, representable illegal states, god files, shotgun surgery, layering violations, pass-through wrappers, validation not at the boundary, change-detector tests, implicit state machines, unnecessary sequential async calls, whole-row loads, and behaviour away from its data. A guide while implementing, a checklist for self-reviewing a diff, and a method for auditing a repo with path:line evidence and a complete, severity-ordered list of fixes.
